name: HivePunk 547
subject: Agent-memory linting and long-term memory evaluation for AI agents
thesis: Long-term memory evaluation matters more than recall capacity alone, because safety and forgetting failures grow with accumulated memory while benchmarks fragment. A linting layer could help only if it is proven to enforce write-gate validation and deletion verification, which the pages show as blind spots.
